# NEW 2026-11-22 v15.5 Module 15.5-B: Ming 2.0 Deep Overhaul (oe_mg2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v155_ming_qing.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Initialize Ming 2.0 bounded state variables once on host.
oe_mg2_init_host = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_cabinet_cohesion } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_cabinet_cohesion value = 55 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_frontier_readiness } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_frontier_readiness value = 45 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_uprising_intensity } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_uprising_intensity value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_events_fired } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_events_fired value = 0 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_mg2_on value = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Clamped variable adjusters.
oe_mg2_add_cabinet = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_cabinet_cohesion } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_cabinet_cohesion value = 55 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_mg2_cabinet_cohesion add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_mg2_cabinet_cohesion min = 0 max = 100 }
}

oe_mg2_add_frontier = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_frontier_readiness } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_frontier_readiness value = 45 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_mg2_frontier_readiness add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_mg2_frontier_readiness min = 0 max = 100 }
}

oe_mg2_add_uprising = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_uprising_intensity } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_uprising_intensity value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_mg2_uprising_intensity add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_mg2_uprising_intensity min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Country scope. Yearly Ming 2.0 progression & chronological 26-event dispatcher (1 event per year max).
oe_mg2_host_yearly = {
	oe_mg2_init_host = yes

	# Gentle yearly crisis pressure tracking during 1595-1675
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1595
			current_year <= 1675
			oe_mg2_late_ming_distress = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_mg2_mod_uprising_pacified }
		}
		oe_mg2_add_uprising = { amt = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_mg2_uprising_intensity
			var:oe_mg2_uprising_intensity > 0
			NOT = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_mg2_late_ming_uprising }
		}
		oe_mg2_add_uprising = { amt = -3 }

	# Chronological event dispatch (at most 1 visible event per yearly tick, each one-shot)

# Any scope. Exported zero-slot yearly dispatcher hook for oe_global_kernel_effects.txt.
# Strictly O(1): dispatches only on live non-rebel MNG (or Han Middle Kingdom leader when MNG does not exist).
oe_mg2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_mg2_ran_y ?= current_year } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_mg2_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:MNG
				c:MNG = { is_rebel_country = no }
			}
			c:MNG = { oe_mg2_host_yearly = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
				exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country
				international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country = {
					oe_mg2_is_host = yes
				}
			}
			international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country = {
				oe_mg2_host_yearly = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
